question: Which two system properties must be combined to explain why the prototype can audit recursive answers?

context_chunks.title: Replayable traces
context_chunks.text: EGRI records replayable traces for recursive sub-calls so that later analysis can inspect which child calls produced evidence for parent synthesis.

context_chunks.title: TraceGuard gate
context_chunks.text: TraceGuard rejects parent claims whose cited evidence handles are missing or stale, forcing answers to remain linked to fresh child evidence.

context_chunks.title: Unrelated baseline
context_chunks.text: A flat baseline answers from a concatenated context without explicit recursive trace metadata.

gold_answers: Replayable recursive traces and TraceGuard's fresh-evidence gate enable auditing.

question: Why is a deterministic offline harness insufficient by itself for an EMNLP empirical claim?

context_chunks.title: Contract tests
context_chunks.text: The deterministic harness checks schema, policy, evaluator, runner, and ablation contracts without calling external language models.

context_chunks.title: Empirical claim
context_chunks.text: An EMNLP empirical claim also needs larger real benchmark subsets and live or realistic model policies to demonstrate task performance beyond contract compliance.

gold_answers: Because contract compliance does not demonstrate performance on larger real benchmark subsets with live or realistic model policies.
